text:
Alex Wang: heads-up — two enterprise prospects (AcmeCorp, FinBank) are asking for feature X but both require compliance guarantees (GDPR residency + SOC2). do we pull this into the next sprint or treat as separate runway?
Monica Reyes: quick thought — RICE alone feels incomplete here because regulatory risk changes impact. propose RICE + Risk multiplier.
Jamal Singh: +1. operationally SOC2 Type II and an ISO audit are multi-sprint efforts. if we fold into the feature sprint we either delay or add scope risk.
Sophie Park: can we ship the UI/UX without the compliance backend and gate the enterprise customers behind a private deployment option? feature-flag the endpoints and restrict to hosted/dedicated later.
Legal: SOC2 Type II usually 3-4 months with an external auditor. GDPR data residency for EU customers may require region-specific infra and KMS changes — estimate 6-10 weeks for engineering plus policy updates. we should assume docs + DPA updates too.
CFO: if we delay feature X, we risk losing ACV from AcmeCorp (~$250k ARR). if we rush compliance we eat 2-3x engineering cost for fast-tracking. need to quantify.
Monica Reyes: suggested scoring snippet:
```
# modified RICE with regulatory risk
RICE = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort
RegulatoryRisk = 1 + (Severity / 10)  # severity 0-10
PriorityScore = RICE / RegulatoryRisk
```
Monica Reyes: example: feature X RICE=120, Severity=7 -> PriorityScore = 120 / 1.7 = 70.6. helps us compare to purely product bets.
Jamal Singh: operational sequencing option A/B:
A) Compliance-first runway: dedicate 2 sprints to infra + audits, then ship feature to enterprise.
B) Feature-first with mitigations: ship product to non-enterprise GA, private deploy + negotiated data-flow for enterprise customers.
Sophie Park: mitigation checklist (short):
- feature-flag enterprise paths
- require customer opt-in for hosted data use
- limit rollout to dev/prod mirrors in approved regions
- add telemetry gate for PII flows
Jamal Singh: we should also consider automated tests + an internal eval harness to detect regressions — reduces Confidence penalty in RICE.
Legal: note: partial mitigations still need contractual language. we can't promise SOC2 and then deliver only mitigations; sales must be explicit.
CFO: proposal — run a 2-week spike to: 1) scope infra changes, 2) update RICE with risk numbers, 3) cost estimate for fast-track vs staged rollout. if spike shows <6 weeks infra work we fast-track, else staged.
Alex Wang: agree. action items:
- Jamal: plan 2-week spike + draft infra runbook (due EOW).
- Monica: run PriorityScore calc across top 6 customer-driven asks and share spreadsheet.
- Legal: draft minimum contractual language for staged rollout.
- Sophie: design feature-flag UX and enterprise gating flows.
product-bot: RFC created: /rfc/compliance-runway-1795004321 (links and owners added) :white_check_mark:
Alex Wang: thanks — we'll sync Thursday 9am to decide fast-track vs staged. :calendar:
